experiment: does the block-weighting principle transfer to a surface parcellation?
finding: Splitting the 19,900 edges into 20 equal blocks and averaging their kernels lifts 0.3432 -> 0.3550 (+0.012) on the surface parcellation. The block-structuring idea transfers. The three exponent values give identical numbers only because my blocks were equal size (995 edges each), so sqrt(size) carries no information within them — a design flaw for the exponent test, not a bug.
next: repeat with UNEQUAL blocks (e.g. Yeo-network sub-blocks) so the sqrt weighting has something to weigh
